disclaimer: Experimental symptom-pattern classifier — not a diagnosis.
clinical_safety_warning: Explicit Clinical Safety Warning: These statistical performance metrics do NOT validate clinical diagnosis, medical efficacy, or emergency triage safety. The dataset covers only 24 synthetic categories and must never be used for direct patient care or diagnostic recommendations.

safety_constraints.leakage_prevention: Exact duplicate texts removed before splitting. Zero duplicate text across train, val, and test splits.
safety_constraints.urgency_model_isolation: Disease prediction is NEVER fed as a feature into the RED/YELLOW/GREEN model.
safety_constraints.patient_isolation: Predictions are never exposed on patient dashboards, confirmation slips, or SMS.
safety_constraints.clinical_governance: Requires qualified healthcare-worker review. Not a diagnosis.
